blocks.text: 1. Vision Language Models
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446424494-371075220.png

The Fine-Tuning LLMs module, already covered across this course, worked purely with text. Vision Language Models, neural networks that understand both images and text together, extend that reach into a second modality.
This topic genuinely opens this course's own Multimodal Deep Learning module, the foundation every other topic in this module builds on.
2. Recapping Image Representation
This connects back to image representation, already covered generally in Convolutional Neural Networks. Images genuinely become grids of pixel values; text genuinely becomes sequences of token IDs.
A vision language model genuinely has to make sense of both of these genuinely different data types together, the exact challenge explored throughout the rest of this topic.
3. Separate Encoders For Each Modality
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446424495-92534687.png

This connects back to recapping image representation, already covered in this topic. A genuinely dedicated image encoder processes visual input; a genuinely separate text encoder processes language input.
Each genuinely encoder produces its own dense vector representation from its own genuinely different modality, a genuinely natural starting structure explored throughout the rest of this topic.

blocks.text: 4. A Joint Embedding Space
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446425080-338472500.png
This connects back to separate encoders for each modality, already covered in this topic. Both genuinely encoders are trained so their outputs land in the exact same shared vector space.
Genuinely related images and text end up genuinely close together in that shared space, the exact core idea explored throughout the rest of this topic.
5. Cross Modal Attention
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446425082-178693822.png

This connects back to a joint embedding space, already covered in this topic. Some genuinely vision language models let text tokens directly attend over image regions, already covered generally in Attention Mechanism.
This genuinely lets the model connect specific words to specific parts of an image, a genuinely finer-grained mechanism explored throughout the rest of this topic.

blocks.title: info
blocks.content: This connection to attention, already covered generally in Attention Mechanism, directly explains why vision language models often build on transformer architectures already covered generally in Transformers, extended to handle image patches as tokens.

blocks.text: 6. Preview Of Contrastive Training
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446425082-36328727.png
This connects back to cross-modal attention, already covered in this topic. A genuinely common training approach pulls matching image-text pairs together and pushes mismatched pairs apart.
This genuinely contrastive idea is covered in full depth as the next topic in this module, briefly previewed here as one genuinely major way these joint embedding spaces actually get trained.
7. Downstream Multimodal Tasks
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446425083-464244762.png

This connects back to a joint embedding space, already covered in this topic. This genuinely shared understanding enables tasks like image captioning, already covered generally in Computer Vision Tasks.

As well as visual question answering and genuinely text-to-image search, all built on the exact same shared representation, a genuinely broad set of practical applications explored throughout the rest of this topic.

blocks.text: 8. Scale Of Multimodal Training Data
This connects back to downstream multimodal tasks, already covered in this topic. Genuinely strong vision language models genuinely train on enormous datasets of paired images and captions.

Genuinely scraped from across the web, echoing the genuinely massive scale already covered generally in Large Language Models, a genuinely real practical requirement explored throughout the rest of this topic.

blocks.text: 11. Key Takeaways

items: Vision language models are neural networks that understand both images and text together.
Images become pixel grids and text becomes token sequences, two very different starting formats.
Separate encoders process each modality, producing their own dense vector representations.
Both encoders are trained so related images and text land close together in a shared embedding space.
Cross-modal attention lets text tokens directly attend over specific image regions.
A common training approach pulls matching pairs together and pushes mismatched pairs apart.
This shared representation enables captioning, visual question answering, and text-to-image search.
Strong vision language models train on enormous web-scraped datasets of paired images and captions.
